static_reasoning.subject: Arguments, entry and effects
static_reasoning.conclusion: Only seven own data string arguments, score/replay and bounded normalized absolute paths. Canonical root is admitted before lazy core import. Ordinary/owned-symlink entry resolves both identities; import-only does not invoke main. No provider, source-packet, collector, transport or retry options; inputs always packets:null. Static code uses only native filesystem, digest/path/util operations and unchanged core.

static_reasoning.subject: All supplied bytes admitted before payload reads
static_reasoning.conclusion: Four/five FDs admitted once with no-follow/nonblocking flags, regular type and exact inherited individual caps. Device/inode duplicates refuse. Summed declared sizes are checked before the first readBytes allocation. Positive short-read loops and one overflow byte, same-FD size/identity/nanosecond-time checks, then final all-FD plus named-path checks catch observed changes across capture. Score individual sum8.75MiB and replay9.75MiB are below aggregate9/10MiB; no invented reachable aggregate fault.

static_reasoning.subject: Close ownership and sticky errors
static_reasoning.conclusion: Numeric ownership becomes undefined before each single close attempt. Existing failures are retained; cleanup never retries a descriptor which a throwing close may have closed/reused. This applies to root, every input, new artifact and parent.

static_reasoning.subject: Explicit output and durable acknowledgment
static_reasoning.conclusion: Scoring and bounded summary precede output creation. Open parent FD first, admit current UID and0700 plus exact identity; exclusive regular0600 singly linked empty output only. Positive bounded short-write loop, file fsync, full same-FD exact readback plus metadata, file close, directory fsync, parent close and final entry checks precede success. Failures retain the explicit empty/partial/full path without unlink, replacement, chmod, retry or another output.

static_reasoning.subject: Original artifact bytes and replay
static_reasoning.conclusion: Adapter passes original native captured buffers to unchanged core, writes exact returned artifact_bytes, keeps all15 rows/final-attempt selection/full measurement companion and inherited unknown/null coverage. Replay receives all five captured documents and never calls writeArtifact. Summary distinguishes core artifact digest from exact file-byte digest and marks synthetic/closed/no model-baseline/no execution authorization.

static_reasoning.subject: Bounded non-echoing acknowledgment
static_reasoning.conclusion: Fixed primitive summary is bounded4096bytes, fixed allowlisted errors are bounded1024bytes, no raw paths/prompts/answers/stacks. Direct entry performs positive short stdout/stderr writes and exit1 on stdio failure. Consumers require both complete summary and exit0; a failed stdout write cannot retract a partial stream.

static_reasoning.subject: Test positive controls and scoped written coverage
static_reasoning.conclusion: All38 distinct named cases read in frozen Git, not executed by reviewer. Actual bounded CLI children/owned terminal absence oracles, actual alternate-root/core/data/rehashed-artifact replay, descriptor-targeted growth/truncation/metadata/short-read/readback/write/fsync faults, root/paths/alias/import refusals, private/exclusive outputs, and close-after-close foreign-FD-reuse assertions have substantive controls. Preload imports actual core before binding faults, and network/subprocess/write denial has explicit activation. Retention assertions in the five failed write-denial cases cannot be promoted to runtime proof.

static_reasoning.conclusion: Guide matches native caps, fullN/null/historical-schema binding, private local filesystem scope, retained uncertainty and Unreleased software-fixture interpretation. Package removals exactly recover original bytes: two new command keys and one immediately adjacent verify path only. Every inherited command/path/order/default and old30 core cases remain byte-exact.
